files.text:
* Pins and parameters are optional; add a body and finish with .ends my_cell.
* .subckt my_cell PIN1 PIN2 params: PARAM1=1
* Non-inverting RC delay approximation
* td: approximate 50% propagation delay
.subckt delay_cell IN OUT params: td=100p
Rdelay IN nd 1k
Cdelay nd 0 {td/(0.693147*1000)}
Ebuf OUT 0 nd 0 1
.ends delay_cell
